tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch9:9-12↗ thm:plane-curve-classification Prove the plane curve classification theorem (Theorem 1.5). [Hint: Show that every smooth unit-speed plane curve $\gamma (t) = (x(t), y(t))$ satisfies the second-order ODE $\gamma ''(t) = \kappa _N(t) N(t)$, where $N$ is the unit normal vector field given by $N(t) = (-y'(t), x'(t))$.] (Used on p. 4.) \end{exercise}
